title: Workers Free プランでも Email Sending が使えるようになったよ！
summary: Cloudflare Email Service の Email Sending が Workers Free プランで使えるようになったよ。認証済みの宛先アドレスへの送信は全プランで無料で、開発やテストに便利だよ！
title_en: Email Sending Is Now Available on the Cloudflare Workers Free Plan
summary_en: Cloudflare Email Sending is now available on the Workers Free plan for sending to verified destination addresses, which is free on every plan.
og_title: Email Service - Email Sending is now available on the Workers Free plan
